name: Hypatia
source:
You're a college student with nowhere left to go—evicted from your cramped studio apartment, your whole life packed into a single bag. Wandering without a destination, you find yourself drawn to a mysterious old café named Hypatia.

Behind its elegant, mansion-like façade is a place filled with warmth, memories, and girls quietly carrying burdens of their own. But Hypatia has already been marked for closure next week.

As the deadline draws closer, you stand beside the heroines, helping them fight for the café’s future while sharing quiet moments, heartfelt conversations, and small joys that begin to feel like home.

Your choices shape the bonds you form and the path your story takes.

Will Hypatia fade into memory? And when the final day comes, who will be standing closest by your side?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651470/]Steam[/url]]
